document_title: The billion buys no building. UT Dell Medical Center, Phase 1

S1.hook: A billion dollars of bare ground
S1.dek: The regents approved adding Phase 1 of the UT Dell Medical Center in Austin to the capital improvement program on August 12th, 2026.
S1.zero_label: FIRST LINE OF THE COST TABLE
S1.source: AGENDA BOOK FOR THE ITEM. COMMUNITY IMPACT FOR THE VOTE.
S1.modeled: MODELED. THE RECORD GIVES COST LINES AND NOT A SITE PLAN

S2.hook: About 27 acres, and what stands on them
S2.quote: a transformative new academic medical destination on an approximately 27-acre site in the center of the west (former) Pickle Research Campus
S2.note: Everything standing on this ground today throws a shadow.
S2.modeled: MODELED. THE RECORD GIVES THE ACREAGE AND NOT WHAT STANDS ON IT

S3.quote: projected to be an approximately 2.5 million gross square feet (GSF) tertiary care medical center with inpatient, outpatient, and clinical support space
S3.note: Nothing on this frame throws a shadow. The board item calls this phase early work and site preparation.
S3.partner: Oncology care, in partnership with MD Anderson.
S3.facility: PROJECT INFORMATION SHEET, "Facility Type Healthcare Facility, Hospital"
S3.modeled: MODELED. THE RECORD GIVES THE FLOOR AREA AND NOT THE NUMBER OF FLOORS

S4.band_label: PHASE 1, ADDED TO THE CAPITAL PROGRAM AUGUST 12TH, 2026
S4.band_source: RECOMMENDED FROM REVENUE FINANCING SYSTEM BOND PROCEEDS
S4.band_line: A phase authorization and a project total are different quantities. The board item states each of them separately.
S4.note: The two figures above were approved by the Chancellor. The phase below is what came to the board.
S4.source: BOARD ITEM, PREVIOUS ACTIONS AND BACKGROUND

S5.quote_1: The $1,000,000,000 in RFS debt is expected to be repaid from clinical revenues.
S5.quote_2: appropriate funds and authorize expenditure of $1,000,000,000 from Revenue Financing System (RFS) Bond Proceeds
S5.note: Clinical revenue is what a hospital earns from treating patients. The building is not open and the debt is.

S6.hook: Twenty pages, no mention of AI
S6.span_label: THE COMMITTEE'S DOCUMENT, END TO END

S8.note: The book names what each item buys. This one says AI in its own title. The amendment adds $5,600,000 to an agreement already running.
